message: Mirrored in X about X12.5: 11 words and 4 codes on 9 blocks (G2 and G3, G41 and G42 swapped). Left 2 blocks as written: 1 return to the reference point, 1 position in machine coordinates. No machine chosen: a word whose reading depends on the machine would refuse the run.

findings.message: Mirroring reverses the cutting direction: climb milling is now conventional milling, and the other way round. Check the cutting data.
A helical move (an arc with a move along the third axis) now turns the other way: a thread milled with it is now the other hand.
G91 G28 Z0.: a position in machine coordinates or an incremental return to the reference point; left as written.
G90 G53 X0. Y0.: a position in machine coordinates or an incremental return to the reference point; left as written.
